name: visual
description: Explain your work in Visual, ask Codex questions, and review change requests on the board before sending them back to this thread.

interface.shortDescription: Explain your work on a narrated whiteboard
interface.longDescription: Opens a narrated Visual whiteboard using this Codex session. Visual can ask read-only questions, or draft a change request for your review. Only clicking Send to Codex authorizes implementation in the same thread. Answers and result summaries require local sharing approval.
